items.title: 54271_Charlie Holmes oral history interview
items.q: I meet Herbie Cowens, a drummer, who I had worked with many a time... Herbie asked me would I like to make a trip to Japan?

ctx.x: Oh, yeah. Well, let me see now. Yeah, I ran into Herbie in Manila. When we were going to Japan... He was on the same boat when we went into Japan, see... Because we had been flying, but one of the planes that one of the shows was using went down in the sea and was never heard of no more, so that the other shows, they got together... That's when Mr. Sylvester Lewis... That's when I started appreciating him. Because all of the managers from all of the big White shows and things, all the shows, they was...
